title: First salary checklist — what to do with your first pay cheque
publisher: Artha Kavach summary of public guidance (RBI / SEBI / IRDAI / Income Tax Dept) — pending manual verification
text: Your first salary sets habits for years. A simple order: (1) Check your offer letter — CTC is not in-hand pay; PF, taxes and insurance reduce it. (2) Open or confirm a salary account and set up UPI. (3) Pay yourself first: automate a SIP or recurring deposit of at least 10–20% on salary day, before you spend. (4) Build an emergency fund, starting with one month of expenses and aiming for six. (5) Take term and health insurance if anyone depends on you or your employer cover is thin. (6) Pick your tax regime and keep proofs for any deductions. (7) Track spending monthly using the 50/30/20 guide. (8) Avoid lifestyle inflation: do not raise your spending just because your pay has risen, and avoid EMIs on phones and gadgets.
summary_hinglish: Pehli salary par: offer letter se in-hand pay samjho, SIP/RD salary wale din automate karo (10-20%), emergency fund shuru karo, zaroorat ho to term aur health insurance lo, tax regime chuno, 50/30/20 se kharcha track karo, aur phone/gadgets par EMI se bacho.
summary_hi: पहली सैलरी पर: ऑफर लेटर से इन-हैंड पे समझें, सैलरी वाले दिन 10-20% की SIP/RD ऑटोमेट करें, आपातकालीन फंड शुरू करें, ज़रूरत हो तो टर्म और हेल्थ इंश्योरेंस लें, टैक्स रिजीम चुनें, 50/30/20 से खर्च ट्रैक करें और फोन/गैजेट पर EMI से बचें।
